articles.title: What Mark Carney’s new plan could mean for Pearson travellers
articles.summary: It’s been a week since Prime Minister Mark Carney said he wants private investors to take over operations at Canada's four largest airports, including Toronto's Pearson airport. And there are still questions around how it could affect travellers. CBC's Talia Ricci breaks down what we know.

Derek Cornelius sustained a non-contact lower-body injury at practice on Wednesday in Toronto, Canada Soccer confirmed in a statement. articles.title: Police investigating fire at Leslieville store selling Hells Angels merchandise
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating a fire that broke out Wednesday at a Leslieville retail store connected to the Hells Angels. They say the fire is now considered suspicious and they are still trying to determine the cause.

articles.title: York police arrest 5, dismantle alleged criminal drug network operating through dark web
articles.summary: York police say they have arrested five people and dismantled a criminal network operating through the dark web following a months-long investigation.

articles.title: 2 people found dead in separate vehicle fires within hours of each other in Etobicoke and Scarborough
articles.summary: Emergency services responded to two fatal vehicle fires within hours of each other Monday night and early Tuesday.
